name: velo
description: Sistema de gestión de incidencias internas — TFG DAM Dual

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run db:incidencias --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.preview:unified: npm run build:vercel && npm run start --prefix backend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:incidencias --prefix backend && npm run seed:admin --prefix backend
